ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a circle with O as the center. Point E and point C are on the same straight line and this straight line passes through O, indicating that EC is a diameter; point A and point B are also on the same straight line and pass through O, indicating that AB is a diameter. In the figure there is a right-angle mark near O, showing that these two diameters are perpendicular to each other, so the central angle between adjacent endpoints is 90°, in particular ∠AOE = 90°. Reasoning: The measure of the minor arc AE is equal to the measure of the central angle ∠AOE, so minor arc AE = 90°. What the problem asks for is \widehat{ACE}, indicating the arc from A to E and passing through C, that is, the major arc of AE. The whole circle is 360°, so \widehat{ACE} = 360° - 90° = 270°.

raw_record.question_text: $\overline{EC}$ and $\overline{AB}$ are diameters of $\odot O$. Find the measure of $\widehat{ACE}$.

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: identify O as the center, with E and C opposite each other on one straight diameter and A and B opposite each other on another straight diameter. Read the right-angle markings at O showing the two diameters are perpendicular, so the central angle between adjacent endpoints A and E is 90°. From the text, the requested arc is \widehat{ACE}, meaning the arc from A to E that passes through C, i.e., the major arc AE rather than the minor arc AE. Since a full circle is 360° and the minor arc AE measures 90°, subtract: 360° - 90° = 270°.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个以 O 为圆心的圆。点 E 与点 C 在同一直线上且该直线经过 O，表示 EC 是直径；点 A 与点 B 也在同一直线上且经过 O，表示 AB 是直径。图中在 O 附近有直角标记，显示这两条直径互相垂直，因此相邻端点之间的圆心角为 90°，特别是 ∠AOE = 90°。推理：弧 AE 的小弧度数等于圆心角 ∠AOE 的度数，所以小弧 AE = 90°。题目要求的是 \widehat{ACE}，表示从 A 到 E 且经过 C 的弧，也就是 AE 的大弧。整个圆是 360°，所以 \widehat{ACE} = 360° - 90° = 270°。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the direct central-angle/major-arc route: use the perpendicular diameters to get the minor arc AE, then take its complement because the named arc passes through C.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the placement of A, C, E on the circle, the center O, the straight diameters through O, and the right-angle markings showing the diameters are perpendicular; also note that C lies on the longer arc from A to E.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the statement that EC and AB are diameters of circle O and the target notation \widehat{ACE}, which specifies the arc from A to E through C.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: A central angle has the same measure as its intercepted minor arc; perpendicular diameters create 90° adjacent arcs; a major arc measure equals 360° minus the corresponding minor arc.
